physical: A body immersed in a fluid is pushed up by a force equal to the weight of the fluid it displaces; it floats if it is less dense than the fluid.
reflected_sentence: A body in a medium is lifted by a Frequency equal to the Desire times Attraction times Vibrance it displaces, and rises when it has less Desire than the medium.
interpretation: Frequency is Desire times Attraction times Vibrance. As Desire and Vibrance rise with Attraction, Frequency rises with them.
closing: The costs array is empty even though density carries resistance, so by the explicit costs list the relation keeps its shape; gravitational field g is not directly in the frozen table (only gravitational pull -> Attraction is), so it is recorded in unmapped_terms.
